lodges.description: Bennett Lake Lodge & Outcamps Ltd. is a float-plane fly-in operation on Bennett Lake, 220 air miles north of Winnipeg. It fishes for northern pike, walleye, whitefish, goldeye, and perch. The lodge runs outcamp cabins in the surrounding lakes. Contact is listed at 1-866-691-3169 and 204-378-5244.

lodges.name: Betula Lake Resort
lodges.location: Seven Sisters Falls / Betula Lake, Whiteshell
lodges.description: A family resort on PR 307 near Seven Sisters Falls, set between Betula Lake and Fisher Lake in the north Whiteshell. The property mixes cottage stays with resort amenities: boat and pontoon rentals, a beach, mini-golf and ice fishing in winter. It is positioned as an easy drive-to family fishing stop an hour or so from Winnipeg. The on-site rentals mean boatless visitors can still get on the water.

lodges.description: A bear and waterfowl hunting outfitter on the Manitoba-Saskatchewan border, run for over 30 years by Judy and family. Fall bear and waterfowl hunts (ducks, snow, blue and Canada geese) run from the Russell lodge along the prairie pothole flyway, while spring bear hunts run from an outcamp at Alonsa between Riding Mountain National Park and Lake Manitoba. They also offer black bear hunt packages paired with walleye fishing out of Russell.

lodges.name: Big Sand Lake Lodge
lodges.description: Big Sand Lake Lodge is a fly-in fishing and hunting destination in northern Manitoba, about 550 miles north of Winnipeg, and describes itself as the only lodge on 60,000 acres of water. All packages include round-trip chartered flights from Winnipeg to its own private landing strip, five-star style accommodations in cabins with indoor plumbing and hot water, home-cooked meals with daily shore lunches, licensed guides, and 18-foot boats with 40 HP Yamaha motors and all fuel. Big Sand Lake is noted for trophy lake trout, northern pike, walleye and arctic grayling, and the operation also runs four outpost camps and world-class moose, black bear and wolf hunting trips.

lodges.name: Big Whiteshell Lodge
lodges.description: A traditional drive-to fishing lodge on the shores of Big Whiteshell Lake in Whiteshell Provincial Park, offering 12 lakefront housekeeping cabins near Rennie. Guests can launch their own boats at the on-site launch or rent one, and the lodge store stocks tackle, groceries and trip essentials. Walleye (pickerel) fishing is the main draw, with ice fishing extending the season into winter. It doubles as a family getaway base, with the park's hiking, beaches and canoe routes close by.

lodges.name: Birdtail Waterfowl
lodges.description: A full-service waterfowl hunting lodge operating beneath both the Central and Mississippi Flyways in Manitoba's prairie pothole country, led by Paul Conchatre. Hunts cover puddle ducks, diving ducks, Canada, snow and Ross' geese, and sandhill cranes over a September-to-November season. It is also an Orvis-endorsed fly-fishing destination with guided stillwater trips for rainbow and brown trout, and ice fishing is listed among its offerings. Capacity is 24 across the main lodge and six cabins, all-inclusive.

lodges.description: Blackwater Cats Outfitter is a fully licensed and insured four-seasons fishing outfitter and guide service based in Winnipeg, Manitoba, operating out of both Lockport and Selkirk. They specialize in giant Red River channel catfish from spring through fall and trophy greenback walleye on the Red River, Winnipeg River, and Lake Winnipeg in the fall and winter ice-fishing season. Owner and head guide Donovan Pearase and his team bring over 20 years of experience targeting huge cats and greenbacks, and the outfit hosts roughly 1,000 guests a year while spending 300+ days annually on the water and ice.

lodges.name: Blue Lakes Resort
lodges.location: Duck Mountain Provincial Park / East & West Blue Lake, Manitoba
lodges.description: A fishing resort on Highway 366 in Duck Mountain Provincial Park, set between East and West Blue Lake with eight rental cabins. The trout fishing is the headline: rainbow, splake, lake trout, brown trout, brook trout and even arctic char swim here, alongside walleye, perch, pike and smallmouth bass. It is one of the few Manitoba drive-to operations with a genuine multi-trout fishery. Note: the business is currently listed for sale (MLS 202424854, 2026) but remains in operation.

lodges.name: Bolton Lake Lodge & Outposts
lodges.description: Bolton Lake Lodge & Outposts is a full-service fly-in lodge on Bolton Lake, 300-310 miles north of Winnipeg. Owners Trevor and Jodi Dick are the second generation to run the lodge, which has operated since 1988. Fishing covers northern pike, walleye, lake trout, whitefish, and brook trout. The operation includes outpost camps on surrounding lakes.

lodges.name: Breezy Creek Adventures
lodges.description: Breezy Creek Adventures is a guide service run by Tim Schellenberg from Petersfield, Manitoba, offering guided boat fishing and scenic cruises. Trips run from Netley Creek out to the Red River, cruising Netley Creek, the Muckles, Medicine Creek, and up to Breezy Point and the Red River. Species on these waters include walleye, sauger, perch, northern pike, white bass, goldeye, channel catfish, carp, drum, and bullhead. The operation is kid- and family-oriented, with contact by phone or email and details on the business website.

lodges.name: Brereton Lake Resort
lodges.description: A drive-to resort on Brereton Lake near Rennie with ten to twelve housekeeping cabins and a full-service restaurant on site. Sixteen-foot fishing boats are available for rent, which covers the lake's walleye and pike water nicely. The restaurant means guests can skip cooking some nights without leaving the property. It is a straightforward family fishing resort in the central Whiteshell.

lodges.name: Bruin Outfitting
lodges.location: Lake Winnipeg (SnoBear ice fishing); Lake of the Woods (open-water musky)
lodges.description: Bruin Outfitting was founded in 2004 by professional guide Matt Cornell, now owner and president of both Bruin Outfitting and Icebound Excursions Inc. In winter the operation runs run-and-gun guided ice trips and guided SnoBear fishing for Lake Winnipeg's roaming greenback walleye, with DIY SnoBear rentals also available. In open water, Thorne Bros and Lund Boats pro Matt Cornell guides musky trips on Lake of the Woods (aboard a Lund 219 GL Pro V with Thorne Bros custom rods and Shimano Tranx reels) plus walleye and multi-species trips at Hecla Island and Lake Winnipeg. Their pitch is full-service: all equipment, techniques, and tackle handled so clients just show up.

lodges.name: Budd's Gunisao Lake Lodge
lodges.description: Budd's Gunisao Lake Lodge is a fly-in fishing lodge on Gunisao Lake, about 250 air miles north of Winnipeg. The lake is one of Manitoba's most consistent producers of Master Angler walleye, and guests also target northern pike. Anglers fish from 18-foot Lund boats with 40-hp Yamaha motors. The lodge operates on the American Plan with gourmet meals, traditional shore lunches, housekeeping, a tackle store, Wi-Fi, and a bar. Published packages cover three, four, and seven days during the May-to-August season.

Caddy Lake's famous rock tunnels make it a fun paddling and exploring destination beyond the fishing. The cabins suit couples and small families looking for a quiet lakefront base.

Dan is a certified professional educator in Manitoba, trained to build fishing adventures for children and for parents of children with special needs, and he is trained in First Aid and CPR and fully insured as an outfitter.

lodges.name: CatDaddy Fishing Guide Service
lodges.description: CatDaddy Fishing Guide Service is a fully licensed fishing outfitter based in Selkirk, Manitoba, about 20 minutes northeast of Winnipeg. Owner and head guide Paul Munroe specializes in catching world-class trophy channel catfish on the historic Red River and also guides for walleye on Lake Winnipeg and Traverse Bay, and walleye or bass on Lake of the Woods. CatDaddy does not subcontract — every trip is run by its own trained guides, bookings are exclusive to one group, and all tackle, bait, gas, and guiding are included. lodges.location: Boggy Creek / Childs Lake, Duck Mountain Provincial Park
lodges.description: A fishing lodge on Childs Lake in Duck Mountain Provincial Park, one of the park's premier lake-trout waters. The lodge runs six cabins plus boat rentals and an on-site store, with a licensed restaurant for evening meals. Species include lake trout, northern pike, walleye and burbot from a deep, cold Shield lake. It is a classic Parkland fishing-camp setup: bring your gear, rent a boat, and fish hard all day.

lodges.name: City Cats Guiding Service
lodges.description: City Cats Guiding Service has specialized in monster channel catfish fishing trips since 1999, running cat tours from mid-May through the end of September. They also run world-famous greenback walleye tours on the Red River in October and November, walleye trips in Whiteshell Provincial Park from mid-May to the end of September, and Lake Winnipeg ice fishing for huge greenback walleye in winter. All bait and equipment is supplied, trips can be customized to specific needs, they can accommodate people with disabilities, and they promise that if you don't have a great day of fishing, your next trip is free.

lodges.name: Cobham River Lodge
lodges.description: Cobham River Lodge is a fly-in lodge on the Cobham River, 235 air miles northeast of Winnipeg. Guests fish for northern pike, walleye, perch, and whitefish. Access is by floatplane from Winnipeg or Bissett. The lodge runs an outcamp at Acheetamo Lake (Hidden Lake Outpost) and operates May through September.

lodges.name: Crescent Beach Cottages & Motel
lodges.description: A four-season cottage and motel resort overlooking West Hawk Lake, steps from the main beach in the south Whiteshell. The property offers one, two and three-bedroom cottages - some with hot tubs and whirlpool tubs - plus six motel rooms, a seasonal store and a year-round laundromat. Travel Manitoba lists a boat launch, watercraft rentals, groomed trails and ice fishing among the amenities. The Pit Stop patio adds food and drinks in summer, making it a full-service base for fishing the crater lake.

lodges.ice_fishing_details: Ice fishing listed as an amenity on Travel Manitoba.

lodges.name: Crunch Time Tackle & Outfitting
lodges.description: Crunch Time Tackle & Outfitting operates out of Beaconia on Lake Winnipeg's east side. Guide Jordan runs ice trips with rods, reels, and lures provided in two ice shack options. The outfit targets walleye through the hard-water season. Trips are listed on FishingBooker starting from US $141.

lodges.name: Dogskin Lake Lodge & Outposts
lodges.description: Dogskin Lake Lodge & Outposts is a fly-in lodge in the Atikaki Provincial Wilderness Park, reached by floatplane from Silver Falls. It operates on the American Plan for northern pike and walleye. The lodge runs outcamps on Mannifrank, North Black, No Name, and South Eagle lakes. Note: it sits near 51.7N, south of the 53N guideline, but is fly-in only.
amenities: outcamps on Mannifrank, North Black, No Name, and South Eagle Lakes

lodges.name: Dunlop's Fishing Lodge
lodges.description: A dedicated walleye and pike fishing lodge on the southeast shore of Lake Winnipeg near Belair, run by Jerry Dunlop. The operation offers seven named lakefront cabins - the Walleye Hole, Trapper's Cabin, Caribou Cottage, Bear Cave, Moose Motel, Wolf Den and Eagle Nest - so groups can book together or individually. Anglers target the lake's famous greenback walleye and northern pike from a true big-water launch point. It is a working fishing lodge rather than a general resort, built around the Lake Winnipeg fishery.

lodges.name: Dunlop's Fly-In Lodge & Outposts
lodges.description: Dunlop's Fly-In Lodge & Outposts is a family-owned operation on Lake Waskaiowaka at the mouth of the Little Churchill River. The main lake is known for trophy northern pike, with walleye as a strong second species. The lodge also runs outpost camps on Pelletier Lake and Campbell Lake. Guided and unguided packages are offered from both Winnipeg and Thompson departure points, with published rates for four, five, and seven days.

lodges.name: Einarsson's Guide Service
lodges.description: Einarsson's Guide Service is a fishing guide operation on the Dauphin River, Manitoba, an area known as a walleye hotspot from May through August. The service offers guided lake fishing trips with shore lunch, plus log cabin accommodations, and is open year-round. Winter ice fishing trips are also offered, making it a year-round guiding option. The business is listed on Travel Manitoba, Interlake Tourism, and Indigenous Outfitters listings, confirming current operation.

packages.name: Guided Lake Fishing
packages.description: Guided lake fishing with shore lunch in the Dauphin River area.

lodges.name: Elk Island Lodge
lodges.description: Elk Island Lodge is a remote fly-in lodge on God's Lake in northeast Manitoba, built around trophy fishing for northern pike, walleye, lake trout and brook trout, with experienced guides and fly-outs to God's River for huge brook trout. The lodge runs ten modern log cabins with showers plus a licensed dining room, bar, hot tubs, tackle shop, games room and fireside lounge. Outpost camps on Edmund Lake and Kistigun Lake extend the fishing beyond the main lodge. Open June to September, it is reached only by air with a 3,800-ft landing strip about 1.5 hours from Winnipeg.

lodges.name: Evergreen Lodge and Resort
lodges.description: Evergreen Lodge and Resort is an all-season drive-to resort run by Ken and Faye Kobelka, set on a quiet bay on the southwest corner of Clearwater Lake near The Pas – one of the three 'true blue' lakes in the world, with crystal-clear, pollutant-free water and long sand beaches. The resort offers fully equipped housekeeping cabins and a comfortable main lodge, plus a solar-powered fly-in walleye outpost camp on Fly-In Lake, 20 minutes by float plane. Guests fish for master-angler lake trout, northern pike, walleye and smallmouth bass with licensed guides and boat rentals, and the lodge also runs guided black bear and duck hunts in the surrounding wilderness. Winter brings heated ice-hut packages on Clearwater Lake.
lodges.address: Box 1228, The Pas, MB R9A 1L2, CA

packages.name: Deluxe Housekeeping Plan (Fishing)
packages.description: Multi-day fishing trip on Clearwater Lake and alternate area lakes. Includes modern cabin (beds, linens, dishes, utensils, barbecue), 20ft boat with 175hp motor on Clearwater or 18ft boat with 40hp motor on alternate lakes with gas and safety gear, fully licensed guide who processes and packages fish, and transportation to an alternate lake on request. Fishing licenses purchased separately. Prices in USD, taxes included: 3 days/4 nights $1,150; 4 days/5 nights $1,550; 5 days/6 nights $1,950; 6 days/7 nights $2,350.

packages.description: 8:00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M., $900 up to 4 people (optional second shift 8:00 P.M. to 7:00 A.M., $300, only with day shift). Includes transportation to and from the heated ice hut, heat on, holes drilled, bait and rods. Hut has propane furnace, stove, oven, microwave, toilet and 4 beds.

lodges.name: Fairy Rock Wilderness Camp
lodges.description: Fairy Rock Wilderness Camp is a fly-in camp on Fairy Rock Lake, about 330 miles north of Winnipeg. Owner Randy Bisschop has run the camp for 20 years. Guests fish for walleye, northern pike, and lake trout. Seven-day packages include groceries, airfare, and a camp manager, and the cabins were rebuilt in 2020.

packages.name: 7-Day Package
packages.description: Includes groceries, airfare, and a camp manager.

lodges.name: Falcon Trails Resort
lodges.description: A family-owned drive-to resort at 100 Ridge Road on Falcon Lake, known for handcrafted lakefront cabins, many with private hot tubs. Hike-in eco-cabins add a backcountry-flavoured option without giving up drive-to convenience, and docks serve anglers on the lake. Travel Manitoba lists Drive-To access and ice fishing, with northern pike, walleye and smallmouth bass among the species. The resort balances fishing access with the trails, beaches and winter activities that make Falcon Lake a year-round draw.
lodges.address: 100 Ridge Road, Falcon Lake MB R0E 0N0
lodges.ice_fishing_details: Ice fishing listed as an amenity on Travel Manitoba.

lodges.name: Fishing Friends Manitoba
lodges.description: Fishing Friends Manitoba is a guided fishing service run by Ron Pratt, covering a wide sweep of Manitoba waters. Trip destinations include the Winnipeg River system from Seven Sisters to Traverse Bay, Whiteshell lakes, the south basin of Lake Winnipeg and Hecla, the Lake Manitoba Narrows, Lake of the Prairies, the Assiniboine River, and Falcon Lake. All rods, tackle, bait, and life jackets are supplied on trips; guests bring their own fishing licence. The business website details each body of water fished and how trips are run.
amenities: rods, tackle, bait and life jackets supplied

lodges.name: Fly Fishing Manitoba
lodges.description: Fly Fishing Manitoba is a specialist fly-fishing guide service run by Robert Burton, described as Manitoba's longest-running fly fishing website, established in 2003. Guided trips focus on the Whiteshell River, where anglers can take walleye, northern pike, smallmouth bass, and three to five trout species in a single day. The guide does not supply a boat, waders, or lodging, so trips are geared toward fly anglers who come equipped. Bookings are handled by text message, with trip details published on the business website.

packages.name: Whiteshell River Trip
packages.description: Guided fly-fishing day trip on the Whiteshell River for walleye, pike, smallmouth bass, and trout species.

lodges.name: For Your Walleyes Only
lodges.description: For Your Walleyes Only is a guided fishing service run by John Boyd out of Dauphin, Manitoba, fishing from May through mid-November. Trips run on Lake of the Prairies, Dauphin Lake, and lakes across the Parkland and Duck Mountain regions, targeting walleye. Full-day and half-day trips are all-inclusive, with bait, tackle, and shore lunch provided. The guide has more than 30 Master Angler awards to his name. Winter ice fishing trips are also referenced on the business website.

lodges.name: FortWhyte Alive
lodges.description: FortWhyte Alive runs a Learn to Ice Fish program in Winnipeg with the Urban Angling Partnership. The sessions teach which rod and reel to use, how to drill a hole, and what equipment and bait are needed. January 2026 sessions sold out, showing steady demand for the beginner-friendly program. It is one of the easiest ways for city anglers to try hard-water fishing without buying gear.

lodges.name: Gangler's North Seal River Lodge
lodges.description: Gangler's North Seal River Lodge sits on Egenolf Lake, about 100 km south of the Nunavut border and 386 km from the nearest road. It is one of four lodges in the Gangler's operation, fishing for northern pike, lake trout, walleye, Arctic grayling, and whitefish. Packages include the Winnipeg charter, guides, meals, and lodging for a maximum of 26-28 guests. Published rates run $6,795-$8,395 USD per person (double occupancy) with a $700-per-day single supplement.

packages.description: Fly-in from Winnipeg with guided fishing, meals, and lodging; $6,795-$8,395 USD per person double occupancy.

lodges.name: Gaune Fishin'
lodges.description: Gaune Fishin' runs guided ice fishing on Lake Winnipeg's south basin, home to the famous greenback walleye. Anglers can book run-and-gun day trips that chase roaming schools of walleye, or stay out in Yetti luxury hardhouses available for day and overnight outings. The operation caters to small groups and travelling anglers looking for a hands-on winter experience. Bookings run through their website and by phone or email.

lodges.name: George Lake Outfitters
lodges.description: George Lake Outfitters has operated in the Whiteshell Provincial Park at Pointe du Bois, Manitoba, since 1993, open year-round on the Winnipeg River. The outfitter rents boats, canoes, and kayaks for fishing on George Lake and the Winnipeg River, and offers waterfront cottages with hot tubs, backcountry camping on George Lake, and campground stays at Eight Foot Falls. In winter, guests can ice fish on George Lake from the outfitter's heated ice shacks. Fishing here is self-guided from rented boats rather than guided trips.

lodges.name: God's Lake Haven
lodges.description: God's Lake Haven is a fly-in fishing lodge on the northeast end of God's Lake in northern Manitoba. It fishes for lake trout, brook trout, northern pike, and walleye. The lodge operates on the American Plan with guided fishing. It is listed in current Manitoba fishing lodge directories.

lodges.name: God's River Lodge
lodges.location: God's Lake (mouth of God's River), northern Manitoba (fly-in)
lodges.description: God's River Lodge is an all-inclusive fly-in lodge at the mouth of the God's River on God's Lake, operating for over 50 years. It advertises northern pike, lake trout, walleye, whitefish, and brook trout, with day-trip fly-outs to Semmens Lake. The lodge's website was live with a rates page in October 2026, and a 2026 guest video confirms current operation. Published Semmens Lake day-trip rates are $450, $600, and $900 USD per person for groups of four, three, and two.

lodges.name: Golden Eagle Lodge (Great White North Wilderness Resorts)
lodges.description: Golden Eagle Lodge is a fly-in lodge and outpost operation in the Lynn Lake area of northwestern Manitoba. It is run by Great White North Wilderness Lodges under Dan McLeod, out of 204-1700 Corydon Avenue in Winnipeg. The operation is listed in current Manitoba outfitter directories with a summer contact of 1-(204) 356-8261. Species for the lodge's waters were not verified from current sources.

lodges.name: Greenback Guiding and Outfitting
lodges.description: Greenback Guiding and Outfitting runs guided walleye trips on Lake Winnipeg from Gimli and Hecla, targeting the lake's famous greenback walleye. The operation offers half-day and full-day guided outings from both ports, year-round, with published rates on its website. Trips are led by local guides fishing the south basin of Lake Winnipeg. The business is based at 1 Centre Street in Gimli, Manitoba.

The operation is run by Lyle and Linda MacMillan. Note: its base lodge is drive-accessible in the town of Lynn Lake, but it runs fly-in fishing trips into remote lakes.

lodges.name: Gull Harbour Marina & Lighthouse Inn
lodges.description: Gull Harbour Marina & Lighthouse Inn on Hecla Island runs two distinct winter fishing products on Lake Winnipeg. The Fish Cave ice shacks are heated shelters with wood stoves that hold up to 8 guests for day rentals. Their SnoBear Adventures put up to 4 guests per machine on guided full-day or half-day trips with shore lunch included. The season runs January 1 to March 31, with booking open for the 2026 season.

lodges.name: Harrop Lake Wilderness Lodge
lodges.description: A remote wilderness lodge in northeastern Manitoba and the only outfitter in its area. Their signature offering is a bear hunting and fishing combo: evening hunts over established bait sites for spring and fall black bears, including color phases, with days free to catch walleye and northern pike during prime fishing season. Bear allocations are deliberately limited to protect the population and improve trophy odds, and they also run moose hunts from the lodge.

lodges.name: Harvest Lodge
lodges.description: A family-owned and operated hunting and fishing lodge on the historic Waterhen River system in central Manitoba. They run guided spring and fall black bear hunts, trophy whitetail deer hunts, and waterfowl hunts for divers, puddle ducks and geese on the central flyway, plus ruffed grouse. The river itself is their calling card for anglers, producing trophy-class walleye along with northern pike, freshwater drum, perch and silver bass. Bear and waterfowl hunters get to fish at no extra charge during their stay, and the lodge runs twelve cabins from simple sleeping cabins to four-bedroom units with full kitchens.

lodges.name: Hastings Bros. Outfitters
lodges.description: Hastings Bros. Outfitters is a long-running Manitoba outfitter based at Windsock Lodge near Bissett, with over 40 years specializing in black bear hunts. Alongside its 5-day guided bear hunts and 6-day winter wolf hunts, the outfitter offers guided fishing on Lake Winnipeg as a standalone product, with ice fishing trips in winter. Fishing is also included during spring and fall bear hunts when seasons overlap. The live website, crawled recently, lists fishing, bear, and wolf products with pricing by email.

lodges.name: Healey's God's Lake Narrows Lodge
lodges.description: Healey's God's Lake Narrows Lodge is a working wilderness outpost at God's Lake Narrows on 65 miles of crystal-clear water known for world-class lake trout — the Manitoba Department of Fisheries certified its all-time record lake trout here in 1998. Guests fish from a fleet of 18-foot Lund boats with 40 HP Yamaha engines, fish locators and live wells, guided by local experts targeting lake trout and northern pike. The lodge leans into homemade hospitality and hearty northern cooking in a serene, off-the-grid setting. It welcomes anglers, hunters and travelers year-round and has hosted visitors like Alex Debogorski of Ice Road Truckers.

lodges.name: Ice Hole Fishing Adventures
lodges.description: Ice Hole Fishing Adventures is a fishing outfitter on Pelican Lake near Ninette, Manitoba, offering guided open-water fishing trips plus boat rentals in summer. In winter the operation runs guided ice fishing trips using SnoBears, rents heated shacks, and offers overnight stays in an Ice Castle fish house. Target species on Pelican Lake include walleye, northern pike, and perch. The business runs year-round with both open-water and hard-water products.

lodges.name: Icebound Excursions
lodges.description: Icebound Excursions has run SnoBear rentals and guided excursions on Lake Winnipeg since 2017, operating as the sister company of Bruin Outfitting & Guide Service under the same ownership. Their SnoBears are heated, tracked machines that cross snow and ice to reach fish anywhere on the lake, equipped with propane furnaces, GPS, Humminbird sonar, and sleeved holes in the floor. Renters drive the machine themselves after a safety overview with the licensed driver; guided excursions add a driver, hole drilling, gear, and a hot lunch. They launch at access points on the south basin including south of Matlock, Manitoba. The operation has been featured in Hooked Magazine and by angling creator Jay Siemens.

lodges.name: Inverness Falls Resort
lodges.description: A resort-style property on Lake Brereton where the Rennie River enters, blending Lakeview Suites, cottages and chalets with whirlpool tubs. The setting is quiet Canadian Shield country with boating, swimming and fishing right out front. Winter guests can book ice-fishing outings on the lake. Its mix of suites and housekeeping cottages makes it a fit for both couples and larger family groups.

lodges.name: Jackson's Lodge & Outposts
lodges.location: Lac du Bonnet base; outpost lakes in northern Manitoba (fly-in)
lodges.description: Jackson's Lodge & Outposts runs 11 fly-in outpost lakes from a base at Lac du Bonnet, with its own air service (Adventure Air). Outpost waters include Little Sass, Echo, Napigon, Upper, Poplar River, and Artery lakes. The family has operated for about three decades, fishing for northern pike and walleye. Published 2026 aircraft rates are listed in Canadian dollars.

lodges.name: Jessica Lake Lodge
lodges.description: A small cabin lodge on Jessica Lake in the Whiteshell, known for walleye, northern pike and yellow perch fishing. Winter brings ice fishing plus an on-site ice rink for non-angling downtime. The lake's modest size makes it easy to learn quickly over a weekend trip. Note: no independently verified website or phone number was found; it is referenced on the whiteshelloutfitters.com lodging page, so anglers should confirm details before planning.

lodges.name: Kannuk Outfitters
lodges.description: Kannuk Outfitters is a fully licensed professional guide service based near Winnipeg, running guided open-water and ice fishing trips on Lake Winnipeg. In winter they target the massive schools of greenback walleye in the south basin with fully guided run-and-gun trips, heated skid houses, luxury Ice Castle overnight accommodations, and corporate events for groups of 8 to 25+. They also offer guided musky trips, fly-in fishing, whitetail hunts, and open-water walleye trips at Hecla Island. Their wheelchair-accessible Ice Castle keeps the operation open to anglers of all abilities.

lodges.name: Kaska Goose Lodge
lodges.location: Mouth of Kaskattama River (Cape Tatnam), north of Gillam, Manitoba (fly-in)
lodges.description: Kaska Goose Lodge is a remote fly-in-only camp on an island at the mouth of the Kaskattama River, about a 20-minute flight north of Gillam in the Hudson Bay Lowlands. It is primarily known as a subarctic waterfowl hunting camp, but it also offers fly-in fishing for sea-run brook trout in the Kaskattama River, documented by Hunt Fish Manitoba and guest reviews. The all-inclusive property includes a main lodge with dining room, hunter lodging, a sauna, and Wi-Fi. It is listed as bookable on major travel platforms in 2026.

lodges.name: Keystone Resort
lodges.description: A family-owned resort on West Hawk Lake since 1991, offering cabins plus motel rooms for anglers and park visitors. The on-site store sells bait, tackle and fishing and hunting licences, so last-minute trip needs are covered without driving back to town. Its position on the crater lake puts deep, clear-water fishing within minutes of the door. The mix of cabin and motel lodging works for both family trips and buddy fishing weekends.

lodges.name: Kickerfish (Central Canada Kayak Trail)
lodges.description: A Manitoba-based kayak fishing tournament organization running the Central Canada Kayak Trail, a catch-photo-release series for walleye and bass with stops at Lake Winnipeg, Wahtopanah, Pelican, Max, Island and Falcon lakes. Events are open entry with no prior kayak experience required, and youth anglers can compete with parent or guardian consent. In winter they run hard-water tournaments including the Icebreaker series qualifiers on Lake Winnipeg, and they publish a live leaderboard with on-the-water coverage.

lodges.location: Russell / Lake of the Prairies, Manitoba
lodges.description: A drive-to resort on Lake of the Prairies near Russell and the Asessippi Ski Area, offering private cabins with fireplaces. The lodge store stocks tackle and operates as a liquor vendor, with a boat launch and fillet shack serving anglers on the reservoir. Lake of the Prairies is known for walleye, pike and perch along its long, winding reaches. The cabins-plus-store setup makes it a convenient stop for Parkland fishing trips.

lodges.name: Kingsland Outfitting
lodges.description: Kingsland Outfitting offers full-day run-and-gun ice fishing trips on Lake Winnipeg and the Red River. The team also runs an Ice Castle placement service for anglers wanting a luxury shelter set over productive water. They market guided walleye trips through the winter season and are actively hiring guides for the 2026 season. Trips are priced per group with a set number of guests included.

lodges.name: Kississing Lake Lodge
lodges.description: Kississing Lake Lodge is a fly-in fishing destination on Kississing Lake, reached by floatplane from Flin Flon via the lodge's own air service, Wings Over Kississing. The lodge pitches a 5-star experience: a chalet-style main lodge with a 26-foot fireplace, private cabins with down duvets, and what it calls legendary local guides at a ratio of one guide per two anglers. Its waters produce trophy northern pike, walleye and lake trout — the lodge notes a single angler can catch 100 fish a day — and it operates nine additional outpost camps on nearby lakes. In September it runs dedicated Northern Lights packages pairing late-season fishing with aurora viewing.

lodges.location: East side of Lake Winnipeg (fly-in from Jack Pine Resort), Manitoba
lodges.description: Kitchi Island Outposts runs fly-in fishing outpost camps on the east side of Lake Winnipeg, flying guests in from Jack Pine Resort about two and a half hours north of Winnipeg. The Kitchi Island camp sits at the mouth of Flour Channel on the Berens River system with over 12 miles of river to fish, plus access to Horseshoe Lake, while the Longhaul camp fishes Longish Lake, known for phenomenal walleye. Each outpost is the only camp on its lake, with a fully equipped cabin and an aluminum boat with outboard for every two or three guests. Target species are walleye and northern pike, with rock bass and perch also present. The live website, copyright 2026, confirms current operation.

packages.name: Outpost Fishing Trips
packages.description: Fly-in remote outpost fishing for walleye and northern pike.

lodges.location: Balsam Harbour, east side of Lake Winnipeg
lodges.description: Lake Winnipeg Ice Fishing Shack Rentals runs heated ice shacks on the east side of Lake Winnipeg at Balsam Harbour (Road 100 North, Beaconia). The fully insulated shacks seat 4-6 people, with the heat on and holes drilled before guests arrive so they can fish comfortably no matter the weather. Shacks are available every day from 7:30am to 7:30pm; reservations are made by phone, text, or email, with full payment by e-transfer after a confirmation email. Cancellations with 48 hours notice get a full refund or reschedule, and weather shutdowns are refunded in full.

lodges.description: Lakeview Hecla Resort is a year-round resort on 360 acres in Hecla Grindstone Provincial Park on the shore of Lake Winnipeg. During the winter season the resort offers guests activities including cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, skating, ice fishing, and tobogganing, with equipment rentals available. Travel Manitoba lists ice fishing among the resort's amenities. It suits families and groups pairing a winter resort stay with time on Lake Winnipeg's ice.

lodges.name: Laurie River Lodge
lodges.description: Laurie River Lodge sits in the narrows between the north and south ends of McGavock Lake, more than 550 miles northwest of Winnipeg, in a 40-by-60-foot log chalet with access to the first 40 miles of the Laurie River system. Its 16 professional guides target trophy northern pike, walleye and lake trout, and guests can add fly-outs to neighboring lakes for even more remote water. The lodge keeps things full-service: modern lakeside cabins with daily maid service, home-cooked meals and shore lunches, plus spring black bear hunt-and-fish combination trips. Open May to September and accessible only by air.

lodges.name: Medicine Creek Adventures

The business offers 3- to 5-day guided fishing packages on the Red River, targeting walleye and channel catfish, with Lake Winnipeg trips also on offer. lodges.description: Moak Lodge calls itself 'one of Manitoba's best drive-to fisheries for trophy Northern Pike, Burbot and Walleye,' located on Cross Bay of Cedar Lake – just north of the 53rd parallel, 450 km north of Winnipeg and 15 km NNW of the town of Grand Rapids. The lodge offers cabin rentals, tent and RV campsites, rental boats, bait, tackle and ice. Cedar Lake was created in the early 1960s by the Grand Rapids hydro dam on the Saskatchewan River; its flooded forest of sunken timber, drop-offs and mix of gravel, limestone and mud bottoms hold walleye, northern pike, lake whitefish, cisco, perch and burbot, and the lodge sits close to stocked trout water. Winter accommodations stay open for ice fishing season.

lodges.name: Molson Lake Lodge
lodges.description: Molson Lake Lodge is a fly-in lodge on Molson Lake, about 30 air miles northeast of Norway House. Hunts run at a one-guide-to-two-hunters ratio with all-inclusive butchering of harvested animals, and fishing packages are sold as dedicated 4-day and 8-day trips.

On site there is a boat launch, beach, store, fishing guides and licence sales, so most of a trip can be handled in one stop. The Narrows' current and structure make it a reliable year-round fishery.

lodges.name: North Haven Resort
lodges.description: North Haven Resort is a full-service five-star fly-in resort on Utik Lake, the only lodge on the 35-mile lake, with what it calls some of the best freshwater fishing in North America for northern pike, walleye and lake trout just steps from your cabin. Guests stay in private lakefront cabins and eat four-course dinners from an executive chef, with shore lunches cooked on remote islands by professional guides. The resort adds a spa with massage services, sauna, fitness center, game room, bar and a business center, plus paddleboards, canoes, kayaks and water bikes for non-fishing hours. Nights bring loon calls, star-filled skies and the northern lights over untouched northern Manitoba wilderness; private air charters run round-trip from Winnipeg.

lodges.name: North Mountain Adventures
lodges.description: North Mountain Adventures is a family owned and operated guiding and outfitting service run by Craig and Melanie MacCarthy from Ochre River, Manitoba, established in 2014. The business is best known for guided black bear and whitetail deer hunts, and also appears on its own Wild TV, Carbon TV, and YouTube series. The location sits 10 minutes from Dauphin Lake and Rainbow Beach Provincial Park, with 4-season cabin accommodations on site.

lodges.name: Nueltin Fly-In Lodges
lodges.description: Nueltin Fly-In Lodges operates on Nueltin Lake in the sub-Arctic wilderness on the Manitoba/Nunavut border, describing itself as operating exclusively on over 14,000 square miles of wilderness — one of Canada's largest tourism resource allocations. Guests fly directly from Winnipeg to a private airstrip on South Nueltin; the lodge also offered guided caribou, moose and black bear hunting. lodges.description: A year-round drive-to lodge on Highway 307 along the south shore of Nutimik Lake, where the Winnipeg River widens. The lodge offers housekeeping cabins in seasonal, premium and deluxe categories, many with full baths, whirlpool tubs, decks and fireplaces. Anglers work the Winnipeg River system for walleye, pike, goldeye, smallmouth bass, perch and whitefish. On site there is Barkley's Diner, a tackle store, beach access and complimentary canoes, kayaks and paddleboards alongside power boat rentals.

Motor boat rentals are available, and a restaurant and store operate from May through September. The river setting gives anglers both lake-style structure and current breaks to work.

lodges.name: Out Of The Blue Aquatic Adventures
lodges.description: Out Of The Blue Aquatic Adventures is a Winnipeg-based guide service holding permits on more than 70 lakes across Manitoba and northwestern Ontario. The operation runs multi-species guided trips in both open water and winter, fishing from a wheelchair-accessible 18-foot Alumacraft. Bait is included, the catch is cleaned for guests, and snacks and drinks are provided on board. Regular departure points include Pelican Lake near Ninette, Stephenfield Lake, and Hecla/Gull Harbour, with booking through FishingBooker.

packages.name: Dunnottar 4-Hour Guided

packages.description: Wood-stove shack rental with pre-drilled holes and firewood.

lodges.ice_fishing_details: Runs winter ice fishing trips in addition to open-water guiding.

lodges.name: Pelican River Outfitters
lodges.description: A family-owned and operated remote hunting and fishing outfitter run by Orin and Dolores Carlson in west-central Manitoba. Their fully guided 6-day black bear hunts run from a wall-tent camp in genuinely remote country, and every bear hunt includes fishing for northern pike, walleye and perch in the surrounding lakes. Gray wolf is also on the menu, and the operation markets the area as one of central Manitoba's truly remote spots for both big bears and big fish.

packages.name: 6-Day Bear Hunt with Fishing
packages.description: Monday-to-Sunday fully guided bear hunt; pike, walleye and perch fishing included

lodges.rates_note: Guidefitter lists bear hunts from $3,500 with $1,000 due at booking.

lodges.name: Pinewood Lodge
lodges.description: A drive-to lodge on Dorothy Lake in Whiteshell Provincial Park offering lakefront chalets rather than basic cabins. Its standout amenity is an indoor salt-water pool, unusual for a Whiteshell fishing lodge, alongside the usual dock and boating access. The lake setting suits anglers after walleye and pike in quieter water. It is positioned as a comfortable family and couples retreat with year-round appeal.

lodges.name: Plum Lake Outfitters
lodges.description: A trophy black bear and whitetail deer outfitter operating drive-to wilderness camps in the Mantagao Wilderness Area near Moosehorn, plus a second bear camp about 4.5 hours north near Wabowden that offers walleye and northern pike fishing. Spring bear season runs late April to mid-June and fall from late August, with timber wolf as an option on fall hunts. Camps are insulated heated buildings with home-cooked meals, and guides run hunters to stands by ATV.

packages.description: Guided spring or fall black bear hunt, all-inclusive

packages.name: Whitetail Hunt
packages.description: Muzzleloader and rifle rut hunts

packages.name: North Camp Fishing
packages.description: Walleye and northern pike fishing at the Wabowden-area camp

lodges.name: Prairie Gal Fishing
lodges.description: Prairie Gal Fishing is a Gimli-based, women-focused ice fishing outfit on Lake Winnipeg. They rent fully equipped heated shacks with live minnows provided, and offer ice fishing lessons aimed at beginners. Rentals run Friday through Sunday, 8am to 4pm, with an optional guided add-on. The operation emphasizes welcoming first-timers and novice anglers to hard-water fishing.

packages.name: Shack Rental (Fri-Sun)
packages.description: Full-gear heated shack rental, 8am-4pm, live minnows included.

packages.name: Guided Add-On
packages.description: Add a guide to the shack rental.

lodges.ice_fishing_details: Heated shack rentals with live minnows plus ice fishing lessons on Lake Winnipeg, Friday through Sunday.

lodges.name: Pro-Am Tackle
lodges.description: A long-standing Winnipeg tackle retailer selling rods, reels, electronics, sonar, live bait (minnows, leeches, night crawlers), fishing licenses and repairs. Its directory listing notes guided trips as an available service, making it one of the few Manitoba tackle shops that also puts customers on fish with a guide.

lodges.name: Red River Cats
lodges.description: Red River Cats, formerly known as Cats on the Red, is a guided channel catfish operation based at 669 River Road in Lockport, Manitoba. The business runs guided trips on the Red River from its boats, the 17-foot Cat House and the 22-foot Taj Mahal. It also rents floating docks and offers river tours alongside its fishing trips. The operation is connected with the Lockport Ice Village, which points to winter ice fishing activity on the river.
lodges.ice_fishing_details: Connected with the Lockport Ice Village; winter ice fishing activity on the Red River.

lodges.name: Riverside Lodge
lodges.description: A historic hunting and fishing lodge in Manitoba's Parkland, outfitting hunters since 1961 under owner Gildas Paradis. It specializes in diver duck hunting from boats over decoys alongside field hunts for puddle ducks and geese, and also runs black bear, whitetail, upland bird and predator hunts across several game hunting areas. Fishing for walleye, northern pike, perch, carp and trout runs summer and winter, with ice fishing shacks on site, plus youth hunting programs.

lodges.name: Riverview Lodge
lodges.location: Seven Sisters Falls / Eleanor Lake, Whiteshell
lodges.description: A year-round drive-to lodge on Eleanor Lake in Whiteshell Provincial Park, about an hour from Winnipeg, run by owners Walter and Margriet Bos. The property offers one and two-bedroom lakefront cabins with fully equipped kitchens, outdoor hot tubs, wood stoves and fire pits, set up for quiet family getaways. Summer brings a private beach, dock swimming and pontoon boat cruises, while winter offers snowmobile trails, cross-country skiing and snowshoeing from the door. The listing is active on the Manitoba Lodges and Outfitters Association directory and the lodge's own site is current.
lodges.address: P.O. Box 114, Seven Sisters Falls MB R0E 1Y0

lodges.name: Sandy River Outfitters
lodges.description: Sandy River Outfitters runs a lodge on the banks of the Winnipeg River, offering fishing for walleye, northern pike, smallmouth bass, goldeye, and other species. The outfitter provides fishing boats and motors and helps guests arrange licences and bait through local vendors. A two-day all-inclusive walleye and northern pike fishing package is available for groups of one to six people. The business has served hunters and anglers for 25 years, and its live website confirms current operation.

packages.name: Walleye and Pike Fishing Package
packages.description: Two-day all-inclusive walleye and northern pike fishing package for groups of 1 to 6.

lodges.name: Sasa-Ginni-Gak Lodge
lodges.location: Sasaginnigak Lake, Atikaki Provincial Wilderness Park, Manitoba (fly-in)
lodges.description: Sasa-Ginni-Gak Lodge (Sas Lodge) is a family-owned fly-in fishing lodge on Sasaginnigak Lake in the Atikaki Provincial Wilderness Park, part of the Pimachiowin Aki UNESCO World Heritage Site. The lodge has welcomed anglers for nearly 60 years, fishing for northern pike, walleye, and lake trout. It runs outcamps on Charron, Apisko, and Keschismeeneko (Cathy's) lakes. The Johnson family operates its own airline, Northway Aviation, for the 45-minute flight in. Note: the lake sits near 51.9N, south of the 53N guideline, but the lodge is fly-in only within a protected wilderness park.
lodges.address: 508 Airline Road, St. Andrews, MB R1A 3P4
amenities: outpost camps on Charron, Apisko, and Keschismeeneko Lakes

lodges.name: Sharron's Outfitting Service
lodges.description: Sharron's Outfitting Service is a year-round, road-accessible outfitter in Sherridon, northern Manitoba. Their Travel Manitoba listing confirms ice fishing among the amenities, with four units sleeping 16 and central showers. Boats, tackle, fish processing, and fishing licences are handled on site. Anglers target lake trout, walleye, and northern pike through the ice season.

packages.name: Winter Fishing Stay
packages.description: Year-round outfitter stay with ice fishing for lake trout, walleye, and pike.

lodges.ice_fishing_details: Year-round road-accessible outfitter offering ice fishing for lake trout, walleye, and northern pike, with lodging, tackle, and licences on site.

lodges.name: Shield Outfitters
lodges.description: Shield Outfitters is a guided fishing service run by Ian Young in the South Whiteshell around Caddy Lake, Manitoba. The outfitter offers half-day, full-day, and full-day backcountry guided trips, plus a pontoon boat excursion on Falcon Lake, with the guide supplying rods, tackle, bait, and the boat; guests bring their own licences. Shore lunch can be added to trips for a per-person fee. Published rates run from $475 for a half day to $900 for a full backcountry day. Winter guiding is also offered, confirmed by the Explore the Whiteshell winter activities guide.
amenities: guide, rods, tackle, bait and boat supplied

lodges.name: Silsby Lake Lodge
lodges.description: Silsby Lake Lodge is a fly-in lodge on Silsby Lake, 400 miles northeast of Winnipeg. Owner Sam Fett has operated the lodge for 42 years, fishing for northern pike, walleye, perch, and whitefish. The lodge has a private 4,000-foot airstrip with direct charter flights from Winnipeg. It also runs outcamps on High Hill and Cuddle Lakes.
amenities: outcamps on High Hill and Cuddle Lakes

lodges.name: Snobear Expeditions
lodges.location: Lockport / Chalet Beach Rd, St. Andrews, Manitoba
lodges.description: Snobear Expeditions runs guided SnoBear trips - heated, mobile ice machines that double as fishing shelters. Lead guide Andy Meyer takes anglers onto Lake Winnipeg, Lake Manitoba, Falcon Lake, and the Winnipeg River through the hard-water season. Trips use Garmin Livescope electronics to find fish under the ice. The operation is listed with both Travel Manitoba and Hunt Fish Manitoba.

packages.name: Guided SnoBear Trip
packages.description: Guided day trip in a heated SnoBear on the water of your choice.

lodges.ice_fishing_details: Guided day trips aboard heated SnoBear ice machines on Lake Winnipeg, Lake Manitoba, Falcon Lake, and the Winnipeg River.

lodges.name: South Shore Lodge
lodges.description: A family-operated fishing lodge on Lake Winnipegosis that has been hosting anglers for more than 35 years, including the Quarry House lodging. It runs walleye fishing packages on one of Manitoba's most productive walleye lakes, known for high catch rates. The setting is classic Parkland fishing camp: boats, guides and shore lunches within a working lodge. Note: the business is currently listed for sale through Frontier Hospitality (2026), but its website is live and it continues to operate.

lodges.name: Tall Timber Lodge
lodges.location: Bird River / Lac du Bonnet area, Manitoba
lodges.description: A family-run operation with more than 60 years of history at Bird River in the Lac du Bonnet area, now primarily a seasonal RV park with a marina. The on-site boat launch, marina slips and store serve anglers working the Bird River and Lac du Bonnet waters. It is better described today as a fishing-friendly campground than a traditional lodge. Seasonal campers and passing boaters make up most of the clientele.
lodges.address: 63 Tall Timber Rd, Bird River MB

lodges.name: Tallpine Lodges
lodges.description: An exclusively couples, adults-only resort on West Hawk Lake with log-style cabins that each include a jacuzzi tub, sauna, full kitchen, barbecue and electric fireplace. Fishing is listed among the free on-site activities, with the crater lake a two-minute walk away, and complimentary canoes, bikes and a paddle boat are included. The resort runs year-round with a heated summer pool, snowmobile rentals and groomed cross-country ski trails in winter. Run by co-owners Sacha and TJ Harder, it is a romance-first property where fishing is a bonus rather than the focus.
lodges.address: 800 West Hawk Blvd, West Hawk Lake MB R0E 2H0

lodges.name: Tawow Lodge
lodges.description: Tawow Lodge is a hunting and fishing camp on Wekusko Lake, about 40 miles from Snow Lake in northern Manitoba, open year-round and accessible by road. The lodge runs guided open-water fishing for trophy walleye, northern pike, sauger, perch, and whitefish, with boats, motors, guides, dock, boat launching, fish processing, and bait included in the operation's services. Guests stay in the main lodge or housekeeping cabins with an unlicensed dining room, and a remote outcamp is available at Woosey Lake. The lodge is listed on Travel Manitoba with fishing guide and ice fishing amenities, and its own website confirms current operation.
lodges.address: Herb Lake Landing, Snow Lake, MB R0B 1M0

packages.description: Six-day guided black bear hunt with lodging, meals, guide, and licence; mornings free for fishing.

lodges.name: TeePee Outfitters (1986) Inc.
lodges.location: Leaf Rapids (Joe T Lake, Numakoos Lake), northern Manitoba (fly-in)
lodges.description: TeePee Outfitters (1986) Inc. is a fly-in fishing outfitter based in Leaf Rapids, Manitoba. Its fishing lodge fishes Joe T Lake and Numakoos Lake for northern pike and walleye. The operation is associated with bush pilot Donna Hohle's air services out of Leaf Rapids on the Churchill River. The year-round phone is 1-(204) 473-2963.
amenities: associated bush pilot air service from Leaf Rapids

lodges.name: The Lodge at Little Duck
lodges.location: Sub-arctic Manitoba, 675 miles north of Winnipeg (fly-in)
lodges.description: The Lodge at Little Duck is a five-star fly-in lodge in sub-arctic Manitoba, roughly 675 miles north of Winnipeg. It targets northern pike, lake trout, and Arctic grayling in waters where 50-inch-class pike and 40-inch-plus lake trout are taken. The lodge has a private 4,000-foot airstrip with a GPS approach and arrivals by twin turbo-prop aircraft. Accommodations include ensuite cabins with chef-prepared meals. The lodge has operated for over four decades with a strict catch-and-release policy.
amenities: complimentary rods, reels, and basic tackle

lodges.name: Trail End Camp & Outfitters
lodges.location: Pointe du Bois (Winnipeg River, north end of Whiteshell Provincial Park)
lodges.description: Trail End Camp & Outfitters is a remote, drive-in, four-seasons fishing and hunting resort on the Winnipeg River at Pointe du Bois, about 1.5 hours from Winnipeg, at the north end of Whiteshell Provincial Park. The camp offers full-service waterfront cabins with private docks, propane barbecues, and decks or screened porches, plus experienced guides and a charter boat fleet (Reel Wilderness Fishing Charters). The newest addition to the family, Kendall Pointe Lodge, is reached by a 14-mile scenic boat trip up the Winnipeg River. In winter they run guided ice fishing excursions on the Winnipeg River and into George and Forbes lakes for lake trout.

lodges.name: Trapper Tom's Outfitting
lodges.description: Trapper Tom's Outfitting is a hunting outfitter run by Tom Nakonechny from Pine River, Manitoba, best known for whitetail deer and black bear hunts in the Duck Mountain region. Alongside hunting, the outfitter explicitly offers guided freshwater fishing trips for lake trout, walleye, northern pike, perch, and multiple trout varieties. Fishing products range from half-day guided trips to remote lodge fishing adventures, with trips listed from $130. The live website confirms current operation.

lodges.name: Turtle Tours
lodges.location: FortWhyte Alive, Lake Devonian, Winnipeg, Manitoba
lodges.description: Turtle Tours is an Indigenous-owned tour company offering ice fishing experiences at FortWhyte Alive in Winnipeg. Their winter setup uses two heated hot tents on Lake Devonian, each with six pre-drilled holes. Half-day and full-day bookings include all gear, and no fishing permit is required. A guided storytelling add-on shares Indigenous fishing traditions alongside the angling.

lodges.location: Wasagaming, Riding Mountain National Park, Manitoba
lodges.description: Turtle Village runs an Indigenous ice fishing village on Clear Lake in Riding Mountain National Park. Their winter setup includes four 12x12 heated hot tents that each fit up to 6 people, with firewood provided. Anglers can book half-day or full-day experiences through the ice season. Species in the lake include walleye, northern pike, yellow perch, whitefish, and lake trout.

lodges.name: Viking Lodge
lodges.description: A drive-to fishing and hunting lodge on the west shore of First Cranberry Lake at the headwaters of the Grass River system, operated by the Wiens family since the 1950s. Guests get boat access to 52 miles of fishable water across five lakes plus portage lakes, chasing walleye, lake trout, northern pike, whitefish, tullibee and stocked rainbow and brook trout. The lodge also sells spring and fall non-resident black bear hunting packages, and runs an on-site tackle shop, marina with boat rentals, restaurant, RV park and a fly-in camp.

lodges.name: Wavey Creek Outfitters
lodges.description: Wavey Creek Outfitters is an active fishing charter operation based on Medicine Creek Road in the RM of St. Andrews, Manitoba. Its business listing identifies it as a fishing charter serving Manitoba waters, with operating status shown as Active. Contact is by phone, and the business maintains its own website. Published trip types and species are not detailed on the listing, so anglers should call ahead for current offerings.

lodges.name: Webber's Lodges
lodges.location: North Knife Lake and Dymond Lake (fly-in)
species: Brook Trout (fly-in only, by prior arrangement)
lodges.description: Webber's Lodges, established 1967 and operated by Dymond Lake Outfitters Ltd., is a family-run fly-in fishing outfitter on North Knife Lake and Dymond Lake in northern Manitoba. After a ten-year hiatus, the lodge relaunched with renovated accommodations, new boats and motors, and a renewed program — open June and July, fly-in only. The main lodge offers four deluxe rooms with ensuites plus a duplex, a licensed dining room and 5-star meals, with boats, motors, gas, guides and fish processing included. It markets catch-and-release fly-in fishing for trophy northern pike, lake trout, whitefish and arctic grayling, with North Knife Lake fished by only 48 guests per year.
lodges.address: P.O. Box 10, Ile des Chenes, Manitoba, Canada R0A 0T0
amenities: boats, motors, gas and oil included

lodges.name: Wekusko Falls Lodge
lodges.description: Wekusko Falls Lodge sits on the Grass River between Wekusko and Tramping lakes near Snow Lake in northern Manitoba, run by Bryan and Elissa Bogdan. The lodge offers guided fishing across a choice of lakes: Tramping Lake for pike, walleye, lake trout and whitefish; Wekusko Lake, Manitoba's top Master Angler sauger lake; plus Reed Lake, Snow Lake, and stocked trout water at Kormans Lake. Services include guides, boat and motor rentals, a filleting shack, tackle, bait, and fish processing. Winter brings one of Canada's longest ice fishing seasons, from mid-November to May 1, with ice fishing packages that include snowmobiling.

lodges.name: Wellman Lake Lodge & RV Park
lodges.description: A drive-to lodge and RV park on Wellman Lake in the Duck Mountain area near Swan River, listed on Travel Manitoba with Drive-To access and ice fishing. The fishery is a strong multi-species mix: lake trout, rainbow trout, smallmouth bass, northern pike, walleye and perch. Guests can book cabins or bring their own rig to the full-service RV sites. It is a practical base for anglers working the Duck Mountain lakes by road.

lodges.name: West Hawk Lake Resort
lodges.description: A year-round cottage resort on West Hawk Lake - Manitoba's famous meteor-crater lake - run by owners Keith and Shannon Henwood. Ten cottages give families and groups a self-contained base steps from one of the province's clearest, deepest lakes. The crater lake's depth and structure hold lake trout, walleye and smallmouth along with stocked rainbows. Year-round operation means it works for both summer trips and winter getaways.
lodges.address: 675 West Hawk Blvd, Whiteshell MB R0E 2H0

lodges.name: White Lake Resort
lodges.description: An all-season resort on White Lake in the Whiteshell, run by owners David and Stefanie Giasson, with cabins built for year-round stays. The property includes a licensed restaurant, convenience store and gas bar, making it a self-contained stop off the main park roads. Rainbow Falls is nearby for guests who want to pair fishing with sightseeing. The cabins and services lean toward family and group trips rather than hardcore angling only.

lodges.name: Whiteshell Lake Resort
lodges.description: A drive-to resort on the south shore of Big Whiteshell Lake near Rennie, catering squarely to anglers with practical fishing infrastructure. The resort rents 16-foot Lund boats and runs a fish cleaning shack with freezing service, so the day's catch is handled properly. Species in the lake include northern pike, walleye, perch, tulibee and whitefish. Its south-shore location puts guests close to the lake's productive bays and islands.

lodges.name: Whiteshell Outfitters
lodges.description: A small owner-operated outfitter run by Mike Adey in the Whiteshell, guiding non-resident hunters since 1981 and specializing in archery tackle and bow hunting. Their all-inclusive 6-day combo packages are spring black bear plus fishing, fall black bear plus fishing plus timber wolf, whitetail deer plus wolf, and wolf-only hunts, with all tags, licenses and meals included. Fishing is part of every bear package: daily lake fishing for walleye, northern pike, yellow perch and black crappie, plus a dedicated Crowduck Lake walleye day with shore lunch on Fridays.

lodges.name: Wolverine Lodge
lodges.description: Wolverine Lodge is a fly-in lodge on Vandekerckhove Lake in northwestern Manitoba. It is the only lodge on roughly 30,000 acres of water. The lodge operates on the American Plan with modern cabins, fishing for northern pike and walleye. It is operated by Great White North Wilderness Lodges under Dan McLeod.

safety:
Manitoba is one of Canada's top ice fishing destinations, with a long winter season and thousands of lakes offering hardwater fishing from December through March. The signature target is the greenback walleye of Lake Winnipeg's south basin — a uniquely colored strain of walleye that draws trophy hunters from across North America — but the province's ice fisheries are far more diverse than one lake. Stocked trout lakes such as Foot Print Lake and Twin Lake produce rainbow, tiger, brown, and brook trout, while northern drive-to lakes like Cedar Lake and Lake Athapapuskow give up walleye, northern pike, lake trout, and burbot.

Access ranges from fully guided day trips to remote lodge stays. SnoBear outfitters on Lake Winnipeg rent heated, self-drive mobile ice shacks or run guided excursions that chase roaming walleye schools, and guides on the Red River put anglers on winter walleye at Lockport and trophy channel catfish through the ice. Lodges such as Bakers Narrows Lodge on Lake Athapapuskow, Moak Lodge on Cedar Lake, and Evergreen Lodge and Resort near The Pas host multi-day ice fishing stays, while experienced anglers can drive to DIY-friendly waters like Twin Lake near Roblin. Outfitters generally supply heated shelters, augers, rods, tackle, and local knowledge, making the sport accessible to first-timers as well as seasoned hardwater anglers.

Safety comes first: Manitoba ice conditions change fast, and checking local ice reports is essential before heading out. Provincial fishing regulations — including seasons, slot limits, and licence requirements — apply on the ice exactly as they do in open water, so review the current Manitoba Angler's Guide before you fish.

Only go on ice at least 10 cm (4 in) thick for ice fishing on foot, 14 cm (5.5 in) for a snowmobile or ATV, and 32 cm (12.5 in) or more for a car or small truck. These minimums assume new, clear, solid ice — double the thickness for white or snow ice.

Ice seldom freezes uniformly; it can be 30 cm thick in one spot and 10 cm a few metres away. Test thickness repeatedly with a spud bar or auger as you move, especially after traveling across cracks or pressure ridges.
Stay away from river inlets and outlets, streams, culverts, and bridge pilings — moving water is the last to freeze and the first to thaw, and ice there is often dangerously thin.
Never venture onto the ice alone; a slip, fall, or breakthrough can be fatal without help nearby.
Before every trip, check local ice thickness reports and follow Manitoba provincial fishing regulations, including season dates and limits.
Tell someone where you are going and when you expect to return, and carry ice picks, a rope, and a charged phone in a waterproof bag.

species_advice.overview: Manitoba's signature sport fish. Lake Winnipeg's famous green-backed walleye draw ice anglers from around the world, while the Red River offers a strong fall run near Lockport.
techniques: Jigging live minnows near bottom on structure
Trolling crankbaits along contours in open water
Drifting with bottom bouncers and nightcrawlers
Ice fishing with rattle baits and jigging spoons
Deadstick rod with live bait next to an active jigging rod
species_advice.best_seasons: Spring and fall open water; September-October fall run on the Red River; prime ice fishing December through March.

species_advice.overview: Manitoba's aggressive ambush predator, found in everything from Lake Winnipeg's bays to remote northern fly-in lakes, with true trophy potential.
techniques: Casting spoons, spinnerbaits and jerkbaits along weed edges and rocky points
Fly fishing with large streamers and poppers on an 8-weight rod
Ice fishing with tip-ups baited with large shiners or sucker minnows
Trolling to cover water and locate active fish
baits: Large shiners or sucker minnows on tip-ups
species_advice.best_seasons: Spring, when pike pack into warming bays and river mouths; steady summer action on weedlines; fall for trophy fish on points and windblown shorelines; winter ice season with tip-ups.

species_advice.overview: Deep, cold shield lakes in northern Manitoba — Lake Athapapuskow, Clearwater, the Cranberry Chain, Wekusko and Kississing — hold some of the biggest lake trout anywhere, and they're very catchable through the ice.
techniques: Jigging heavy tubes, jigs and spoons on deep structure
Dead sticking with ciscos on points or saddles
Trolling deep with downriggers or lead-core line in summer
Casting bucktail jigs in shallow water during spring and fall
species_advice.best_seasons: Winter through the ice; late August to early September when big females move onto shallow rocky reefs for the fall spawn; early spring when trout ride higher in the water column.

species_advice.overview: The Red River below the Lockport Dam is one of North America's premier trophy channel cat fisheries, with 20-plus-pound fish common and 30-pounders attainable.
techniques: Slip-sinker bottom rigging behind an anchored boat
Slip-bobber float fishing along current edges
Anchoring at the head or edge of holes and casting rigs downriver
species_advice.best_seasons: Late May-June prespawn bite in tailwaters is the peak; fishing stays strong through summer and into October.

species_advice.overview: Clear Canadian Shield lakes in Nopiming and Whiteshell Provincial Parks grow aggressive smallmouth that feed heavily on crayfish around rocks and boulders.
techniques: Casting tube jigs along rocky points and boulders
Drop shotting near deeper structure
Jerkbait retrieves along shorelines
Topwater walking baits early in the day
Finesse presentations on subtle points and corners
species_advice.best_seasons: Late spring through early fall; late fall can produce when fish school up.

species_advice.overview: Manitoba's Interlake shoal lakes produce jumbo perch, and Lake Winnipeg perch keep ice anglers busy all winter with fast, tasty action.
techniques: Jigging small tungsten jigs and spoons tipped with bait
Dead sticking with live minnows on ultra-light rods
Rattle baits when perch are aggressive
species_advice.best_seasons: Winter ice season, especially late ice in March when perch move shallow; summer jigging in deeper water.

species_advice.overview: Manitoba's freshwater cod is a winter specialty — Cedar Lake is famous for its burbot spawn under the ice, and the Red River's deeper stretches hold them too.
techniques: Night jigging with heavy glow spoons
Dead sticking with scented bait near bottom
Tip-ups rigged just off bottom overnight
species_advice.best_seasons: Winter, peaking around the March spawn under the ice.

species_advice.overview: An underrated ice-fishing target in Manitoba — Lake Winnipeg and Cedar Lake both hold trophy-class whitefish that reward a finesse approach.
techniques: Finesse jigging with compact spoons and jigs
Staying mobile to locate roaming schools
Light presentations that keep the lure above the fish

species_advice.overview: A Manitoba river classic — bright silver, eager biters in the Red, Assiniboine and Winnipeg Rivers, and the province's famous smoked fish delicacy.
techniques: Slip-bobber fishing with worms close to shore
Casting small spinners, spoons and jigs
species_advice.best_seasons: Spring and early summer as river water warms; active through the summer months.

species_advice.overview: Manitoba stocks rainbows in lakes like Footprint Lake and throughout the Whiteshell, giving shore and ice anglers fun, hard-fighting trout close to home.
techniques: Still fishing with a small jig and nightcrawler a foot or two off bottom
Casting small spoons and spinners
Fly fishing with streamers and leech patterns in fall
species_advice.best_seasons: Fall, when stocked trout feed aggressively on shallow weed flats; winter through the ice; spring after ice-out.

master_angler.about: The Manitoba Master Angler Program is a trophy-fish recognition program run by Travel Manitoba (with the Manitoba Wildlife Federation historically involved). Any angler who catches a fish in Manitoba meeting or exceeding the program's minimum length for one of 30 eligible species can register it. Awards are given per qualifying fish, with bronze/silver/gold/platinum/diamond milestone badges for number of different species caught, plus specialist badges per species, and special recognition for catch-and-release. Program website: anglers.travelmanitoba.com.
how_it_works: Catch a fish in Manitoba (in accordance with provincial angling regulations, using hook and line) that meets or exceeds the minimum length for its species.
Take a horizontal measurement photo of the entire length of the fish against a ruler, measuring tape or bump board (photo must meet rule #3; action photo optional but encouraged).
Submissions with images showing vertical gill/eye holds, weigh-scale or fish-stringer holds, frozen fish declared as released, thumbnails/screen captures, or blood in photos are not accepted.
Submit digitally through the Master Angler Awards website (anglers.travelmanitoba.com) or the Master Angler mobile app within one year of the catch.
Travel Manitoba is the sole and final judge of entries.

Every qualifying fish receives a certificate (digital certificate by email for non-level-achieving catches; mailed hard copy for the first Master Angler award and when a new level or specialist badge is achieved); catch-and-release catches earn a special release recognition/crest.
